thesis: Children need protected present dignity and supported development of future agency.

ideas.statement: Responsibility grows with participation and proportionate repair; adults must make promises credible and avoid transferring their own burdens under the praise of maturity.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Waiting tasks reflect environmental reliability as well as control, not destiny; hearing children is not unlimited choice, and victim protection remains necessary.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Waiting tasks reflect environmental reliability as well as control, not destiny; hearing children is not unlimited choice, and victim protection remains necessary.
